# Misal Works

> Misal Works is Bayram Şimşekoğlu’s film and post-production studio in Istanbul. Services: advertising and promo films, motion graphics, 3D/CGI, VFX compositing, color grading, AI-assisted visual development, script-to-shoot production. Contact: hello@misalworks.com · +90 (216) 599 0134 · Justwork, Fatih Sultan Mehmet Mah., Balkan Cad., No:62A, 34770 Ümraniye / İstanbul.

## Services

- [Kurgu / Editing](https://misalworks.com/#services): Video editing, sound, pacing for film delivery.
- [Hareketli grafik / Motion graphics](https://misalworks.com/#services): Titles, explainers, social cuts.
- [3D görselleştirme / 3D CGI](https://misalworks.com/#services): Product, environment, digital scenes.
- [Görsel efekt / VFX](https://misalworks.com/#services): Compositing, tracking, cleanup.
- [AI görsel üretim](https://misalworks.com/#services): AI-assisted shots integrated into edit and grade.
- [Renk ve kamera takibi](https://misalworks.com/#services): Grading and screen/track inserts.
- [Senaryo ve çekim](https://misalworks.com/#services): Script, crew, shoot management.

## Work

- [Selected works gallery](https://misalworks.com/#work): Ads, outdoor LED, social, medical, exhibition films.
- [Showreel](https://misalworks.com/#showreel): Short cut of recent work (YouTube embed).
